items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Nat Jones played clarinet just like Barney Bigard

ctx.x: Nat Jones played clarinet just like Barney Bigard, and alto -- I can't describe the style. It was different, a very interesting thing. It caught Duke's ear. And he went out with Duke for a while, you know. But they didn't like that road.
